purpose: The 2026-08-05 steady-state run's ONE labelling sitting: its crawl-leg record-and-rank residue and its own dive leg, cut once against a single 1000-row cap and served blind. This directory is NOT a batch: no images.jsonl, no labels, no registration. The rows live in the two registered batches named in source_batches; the single export routes back through route.json (merge_scores.py --route).
order_rule: seeded shuffle over the union, then stratified round-robin over every (source_batch x family) cell to +/-1 of proportional share in every prefix
calibration_aids: NONE — no exemplars, no reference strip, no score shown
